name: Session-Mean Stretch Reversion
hypothesis: In range-bound H1 regimes, a 2.5 SD stretch from the broker-day mean rejected at a new session extreme reverts to the mean.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop beyond the session extreme plus 0.25 M15 ATR; target = session mean, admitted only at >=2.2R; exit by min(6h, next broker gap).
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
